name: PT Pollux Hotels Group Tbk
summary: PT Pollux Hotels Group Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the property and real estate development in Indonesia. It operates through Mall, Developer, Hotel, and Administrator segments. The company also engages in construction, management, and rental of buildings, offices, malls, hotels, shophouses, and amusement parks; property management and development; and construction, hotel, and apartment management activities. It is also involved in the hospitality business; direct equity investment and trading activities; and provision of development and delivery services.
